cta_description: Write a letter to your future self. When the time comes, Dao Dao will deliver it back to you.
dialog_description: A quiet space that belongs only to you.
anti_pressure_title: It does not need to be complete or polished
anti_pressure_description: This is not an assignment or a goal. A small, honest note from this moment is enough.
privacy_promise: Only you can see it. Once sent, it is sealed and cannot be edited, but you can permanently delete it anytime. Dao Dao will not rewrite your words with AI.
help_tips_title: Not sure where to start? Try one of these
help_tip_reason: Write down a reason you would only admit to yourself: why you are doing what you do now
help_tip_question: Ask your future self a question. You do not need an answer; you just want to know how things turned out
help_tip_unsaid: Write one thing you want to tell yourself today but cannot say out loud
help_avoid_title: Things you do not need to do
help_avoid_formal: It does not have to read like a "proper" letter, with a beginning and an end
help_avoid_positive: No need to pretend to be positive, motivated, or sure of yourself
help_avoid_promise: No need to promise what your future self will achieve
field_message_to_future: What to say to your future self
field_message_help: Write about your hopes, what you want to achieve, or a reminder for your future self
letter_save_failed: Could not save. Please try again.
letter_send_failed: Could not send. Please try again.
letter_delete_failed: Could not delete. Please try again.
close_auto_save_hint: Closing saves automatically; an empty letter does not create a draft.
validation_one_field: Write in either field when you feel ready to send.
delete_draft_message: This cannot be undone. Cancel keeps your current writing.
delete_scheduled_message: Permanently deleting it means it will never arrive and cannot be restored.
delete_delivered_message: It will disappear from your timeline and cannot be restored.
draft_continue_hint: Finish writing, pick a time, and send it.
sealed_description: Its contents are sealed until the delivery date, {date} — even from you.
unopened_title: A letter from your past has arrived
unopened_description: Open it whenever you feel ready. There is no deadline.
letter_open_failed: Could not open the letter. Please try again later.
timeline_empty: No learning footprints yet. Write a letter to start your journey!
timeline_error: Could not load the timeline. Please try again.
timeline_quiet_description: A collection of moments, without streaks or progress pressure.
detail_time_span: Written on {from}, delivered on {to} ({days} days ago)
detail_message_label: What you said to your future self
detail_now_placeholder: Write your current state and compare with your past self...
